ToolOptions.NextNumber.zh: 当前画布的下一个序号

ToolDescription.Select.zh: 选择并调整画布中的元素。

ToolDescription.Highlighter.zh: 用半透明笔迹突出内容。

ToolDescription.Line.zh: 拖动绘制直线，分别设置两个端点。
ToolDescription.Line.en: Drag a line and style its two endpoints independently.

ToolDescription.Rectangle.zh: 绘制矩形，或单击插入默认尺寸。
ToolDescription.Rectangle.en: Draw a rectangle, or click to insert its default size.

ToolDescription.Ellipse.zh: 绘制椭圆，或单击插入默认尺寸。
ToolDescription.Ellipse.en: Draw an ellipse, or click to insert its default size.

ToolDescription.Symbol.zh: 选择图案，单击插入或拖动确定尺寸。
ToolDescription.Symbol.en: Choose a symbol, then click to insert or drag its size.

ToolDescription.Text.zh: 单击输入文字，双击已有文字继续编辑。
ToolDescription.Text.en: Click to type; double-click existing text to edit it.

ToolDescription.Number.zh: 连续插入序号；当前序号随画布保存。
ToolDescription.Number.en: Insert sequential numbers; the current counter belongs to the canvas.

ToolDescription.Image.zh: 从剪贴板、文件或拖放导入图片。
ToolDescription.Image.en: Import images from the clipboard, files, or drag and drop.

ToolDescription.Eraser.zh: 拖动擦除接触到的整个元素。
ToolDescription.Eraser.en: Drag to erase whole elements under the pointer.

ToolDescription.Crop.zh: 选中一张可编辑图片，拖动设置其裁剪范围。
ToolDescription.Crop.en: Select one editable image, then drag its crop area.

ToolDescription.Blur.zh: 在实时画布上拖出动态模糊区域，随下层画面更新。
ToolDescription.Blur.en: Drag a live blur region that follows changes underneath.

ToolDescription.Pixelate.zh: 拖动设置需要马赛克的区域。
ToolDescription.Pixelate.en: Drag to mark a pixelated region.

ToolDescription.CaptureRegion.zh: 圈选后原位插入静像。多边形：点回起点、Enter 或双击完成；Backspace 撤点，Esc 取消。
ToolDescription.CaptureRegion.en: Select a region to insert a snapshot in place. Polygon: click the start, press Enter or double-click to finish; Backspace removes a vertex, Esc cancels.

ToolDescription.Emoji.zh: 选择表情，单击连续插入。
ToolDescription.Emoji.en: Choose an emoji, then click to insert copies.

ToolDescription.Stamp.zh: 选择已保存的印章并放置到画布。
ToolDescription.Stamp.en: Choose a saved stamp and place it on the canvas.
